# graviteeam_trust_domain (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM workload identity trust domain

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_trust_domain" "example" {
  domain_id                = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name                     = "workloads.example.com"
  description              = "External workload identities"
  bundle_source            = "JWKS_URL"
  jwks_url                 = "https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/certs"
  refresh_interval_seconds = 300
  allowed_algorithms       = ["RS256"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bundle_source` (String) The trust bundle source. Gravitee AM 4.12 supports JWKS_URL
- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this trust domain belongs to
- `jwks_url` (String) The URL from which Gravitee AM refreshes the JWKS trust bundle
- `name` (String) The SPIFFE trust domain name

### Optional

- `allowed_algorithms` (List of String) JWT signature algorithms accepted from this trust domain
- `description` (String) A description of the trust domain
- `refresh_interval_seconds` (Number) The JWKS refresh interval in seconds

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Creation time as an epoch timestamp in milliseconds
- `id` (String) The ID of the trust domain
- `updated_at` (Number) Last update time as an epoch timestamp in milliseconds
